thread:
elaine-cs: NightMarket reached out — their webhooks to https://hooks.redwood.example/events started failing right after our maintenance window. They say their firewall only allows 52.34.12.8 and see TLS errors.

nightmarket-cust: "webhooks fail with ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR. Our logs show incoming connection from 52.34.15.14, not 52.34.12.8"

elaine-cs: quick repro from their side:
```
curl -v https://hooks.redwood.example/events
* Connected to hooks.redwood.example (52.34.15.14) port 443
* TLS handshake error: SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL
```

hema-network: Confirmed — we ran a scheduled SNAT rebalance in us-west-2 during the window (2026-03-17T03:12Z). Node previously egressed from 52.34.12.8, new ephemeral allocation landed in 52.34.15.8/29 (observed 52.34.15.14). This is normal for the autoscaling/rebalance job.

lucas-sre: Short-term: ask NightMarket to add the specific new IP (52.34.15.14) or the whole /29 (52.34.15.8/29) to their allowlist to avoid immediate failures. Longer-term options: reserved/sticky egress or advertise SNI-based firewalling if they can match hostname.

sam-support: Action items: @elaine-cs confirm customer adds the IP, @hema-network open reserved-egress request for NightMarket (P2). I'll tell NightMarket we're on it and offer the reserved option.

deploy-bot: [infra] NAT-rebalance completed — rotated 8 SNAT addrs in us-west-2 at 2026-03-17T03:12:07Z.

nightmarket-cust: Updated allowlist with 52.34.15.14, webhooks resumed. Can you file the permanent egress request? Need a static IP for compliance.

elaine-cs: Got it — I'll collect IP/ASN requirements and open the reserved allocation ticket. Noting customer needs: single static egress IP, SLA for change notification, and firewall allowlist guidance.

sam-support: Temporary fix validated, reserved-eip ticket being created. Will follow up with ETA and handover to account team. :thumbsup:
